name: Supplier & Margin
focus: EU sourcing, landed cost and supplier consolidation for 20–50 SKUs
summary: BigBuy remains the strongest consolidation path for the pet cluster. Two Muda Cero components are publicly priced at €2.57 and €5.43. The current reusable roller candidate at $6.73 is about €5.89 at 1 USD = 0.875274 EUR, taking the 3-piece product subtotal to about €13.89 before shipping. At Finance's €39.90 test price and €16.49 non-ad cost ceiling, only €2.60 remains for shipping, fees and returns, so this roller path is too tight for GO. A $49 soft dog-seat cover and $41.24 six-piece packing cube set fail economics; a $16.10 windshield umbrella and $22.81 five-piece compression set remain WATCH because EU ship-from and exact shipping are not publicly verified.
blocker: Need a cheaper Spain/EU reusable pet-hair roller or an exact full-kit shipping quote. Product-level EU ship-from and shipping cost remain unverified for the top challenger SKUs.
